comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Footwear brand owner selling mostly wholesale; QVC is a multi-category video and online retailer of third-party goods.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Pawn and consumer lending with used goods; financial services business, not a general merchandise TV and online retailer.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: Wholesale apparel brand company and licensor; differs from QVC's direct-to-consumer multi-category TV and online retailing.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Digital media publisher earning advertising and affiliate revenue, not selling merchandise directly to consumers.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Regional supermarket and fuel operator selling groceries; different products and shopping behavior from discretionary TV and online retail.

comps.label: C6
comps.reason: Secondhand thrift store operator relying on donated goods in physical stores; differs from QVC's branded TV and online sales.

comps.label: C7
comps.reason: Single premium apparel brand with stores and wholesale; QVC is a broad multi-category TV and online retailer.

comps.label: C8
comps.reason: Multichannel home and lifestyle retailer selling to consumers online and via catalogs, with own private-label brands, like QVC's home business.
